metadata.description: Enhanced affirmative treatments in Ernest Holmes' style

treatments.title: Morning Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that I am one with Infinite Intelligence, that Divine Mind lives through me, and that Spiritual Law operates through my consciousness. I am a channel for the Creative Power of the universe, and all that I need is already provided. I walk in the consciousness of my oneness with the Infinite, and my life is a perfect expression of Divine Intelligence.

treatments.title: Healing Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that Divine Intelligence is my life, that Spiritual Law operates through me, and that I am one with the healing power of the universe. My body is a perfect expression of Divine Intelligence, and every cell responds to the Truth of wholeness. I am whole, perfect, and complete, for I am one with the Infinite Source of all good.

treatments.title: Prosperity Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that I am one with the Infinite Source of all abundance, that Divine Intelligence guides me to my highest good, and that Spiritual Law operates for my prosperity. The Creative Power of the universe flows through me abundantly, and all that I need is already provided. I walk in the consciousness of abundance, and my life reflects the infinite nature of Spirit.

treatments.title: Relationship Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that Divine Love flows through all my relationships, and that Spiritual Law brings harmony and understanding. I see each person as a spiritual being, perfect in their essence, and I attract to myself that which I am. My relationships are mirrors of my own consciousness, reflecting the Truth of my oneness with the Infinite.

treatments.title: Purpose Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that my purpose is to express the Divine Intelligence that lives within me. I am here to demonstrate the Truth of my being—that I am a spiritual being having a human experience. I am a channel for the Creative Power that flows through me, and I express the Infinite in all that I do.

treatments.title: Purpose and Direction Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that my purpose is to express the Divine Intelligence that lives within me. I am here to demonstrate the Truth of my being—that I am a spiritual being having a human experience. Divine Intelligence guides me to my right place and right activity, and I trust the process of my spiritual unfoldment. I am a channel for the Creative Power that flows through me, and I express the Infinite in all that I do.

treatments.title: Understanding and Wisdom Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that Divine Intelligence is always available to guide and inspire me. My spiritual understanding grows as I apply spiritual principles in my daily life and recognize the presence of Divine Intelligence in all my experiences. I am open to receiving wisdom and guidance from the Infinite, and I trust that all understanding comes through my direct experience of oneness with Divine Mind.

treatments.title: Faith and Trust Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that faith is my conscious recognition of spiritual law and its operation. I understand that Principle never fails to respond to my recognition of It, and I trust that the Creative Power of the universe is always available and always responding to my consciousness. My faith grows as I experience the operation of spiritual law in my life and recognize that Divine Intelligence is always working for my highest good.

treatments.title: Transformation Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that I have the power to choose my thoughts and that my thoughts create my experience. I replace negative thoughts with affirmative treatments that recognize the Truth of my being. The Creative Power within me can transform any situation, and I trust that Divine Intelligence is always working through me, bringing about my highest good in perfect ways.

treatments.title: Spiritual Practice Treatment
treatments.treatment: I recognize that my spiritual practice is working when I experience greater peace, understanding, and harmony in my life. I know the Truth, and the Truth makes me free. I trust the process of my spiritual development and recognize that Divine Intelligence is always working through me, bringing about my highest good. My practice brings me closer to my divine nature and opens me to greater expression of the Infinite.
